Raise: Decaying Colossus
69% of base mana
3 sec cast
Raise a Decaying Colossus to aid you in combat, occupying 3 Life Force.

While active, 25% of all damage taken by the caster is taken by the Decaying Colossus.

Command: Unleash a powerful attack dealing Weapon Damage plus 100+1.0 Points Per Level to all enemies in front of it.
